archive.title: 1928 World Series
archive.caption: The 1928 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1928 season.

archive.title: 1946 World Series
archive.caption: The 1946 World Series was played in October 1946 between the St. Louis Cardinals and the Boston Red Sox. This was the Red Sox' first appearance in a World Series since their championship of 1918.

archive.title: Busch Memorial Stadium
archive.caption: Busch Memorial Stadium was a multi-purpose sports facility in St. Louis, Missouri, that operated for 40 years, from 1966 through 2005.
